question: On the next 20 unused development notes in frozen corpus order, does unchanged ASv6.10 reduce added model commentary and newly calculated results without losing represented meanings, compared with frozen ASv6.8?
execution_order: asv6.8/config.json: all 20 notes in frozen order
asv6.10/config.json: the identical 20 notes in the identical order
review: Assistant reads every returned subject against the complete original note for added or missing meaning. Questionable cases are prepared for the existing review TUI, with no user decisions prefilled.
interpretation_rules: Broad, nested, overlapping and duplicate subjects are allowed.
Plausible implications and supported alternative interpretations are allowed.
Preserve source-expressed uncertainty and negation. Neither uncertainty words nor negation automatically constitute added commentary.
Do not demand one canonical subject list or treat all differences between versions as defects.
Separate definite observations from uncertain assistant judgments; ask the user about the latter.
limitations: 20 notes from an existing frozen corpus, not a random sample of all Nostr.
Unused refers to the saved development inputs listed in selection.json; earlier corpus-wide processing may have encoded these notes.
One generation per note per version cannot establish repeatability or attribute a difference causally.
Multiple prompt changes are compared as a package; this does not isolate their effects.

runtime.cap_scope: Pinned Codex launches a separate codex.slice scope, so launcher limits/measurements are not whole-Codex limits/measurements.
runtime.resource_checks: Sequential calls only. Check host MemAvailable and memory/I/O pressure during generation; pause if pressure develops.
runtime.budget_ledger: Read before generation. No new paid commitment: existing subscription only.
